title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 4. Recalls that the rules on the burden of proof and the recognition of occupational diseases fall within the competence of the Member States and their social security systems; opposes any presumption of causality that would require the employer to prove a negative, to the detriment of legal certainty, particularly for SMEs; calls on Member States to exchange best practices regarding the recognition of work-related mental health conditions;
